About Me

I'm Nolan, a front-end developer focused on clean code, intuitive interfaces, and experiences that feel as good as they look.

For the past 10 years, I've explored what makes a great user experience through front-end development, design, branding, and user research. Today, I'm using my own business, Groove Nest, as a way to gain real-world experience, refine my skills, and build products shaped by real customer feedback.
